join: normalised trade name: CDC active product trade name vs FDA 'Vaccines Licensed for Use in the United States' trade name
method: 20 pairs drawn with random.seed(20261120) from the 58 exact normalised matches by vax_measure.py; each pair read by hand, comparing the FDA product name with the CDC CVX short description and manufacturer
note: Exact matches are clean; the risk is in what does not match: 55 of 113 CDC active names carry a formulation suffix (e.g. 'Afluria quadrivalent, preservative free') and one FDA trade name can cover several CVX codes (SPIKEVAX maps to more than one CVX), so a trade name selects a product family, not one CVX code.
